# clio validate

attest, update, invalidate, or delete one item

## Usage

```
clio validate ITEM_ID --action attest|update|invalidate|delete [--note N] [--new-content C] [--bank BANK] [--actor ACTOR] [--output json|text]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ITEM_ID` | yes | The id of the item under review; `validate` sends it to the `validate` tool as `item_id`. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--action attest\|update\|invalidate\|delete` | enum: attest, update, invalidate, delete |  | Selects the review action that `cli_write_shared::validate_call` validates against `attest`, `update`, `invalidate`, or `delete` before calling the `validate` tool. |
| `--note N` | text |  | Carries the reviewer note that `cli_write_shared::validate_call` passes to the `validate` tool as `note`. |
| `--new-content C` | text |  | Carries the replacement text that `cli_write_shared::validate_call` passes to the `validate` tool as `new_content`. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the review to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the `validate` tool. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the `validate` tool. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio validate itm-sample-1 --action attest --note "reviewed" --db ./memory.db
```

update carries the replacement
```
clio validate itm-sample-1 --action update --new-content "Toronto" --note "user fix"
```

```
clio validate itm-sample-1 --action attest -o json --db ./memory.db
```
